desc:
Welcome to Steal From Fish! 🐟 
 
How many Fish can you STEAL? Remember.. Dont anger the Fish Monsters protecting the base! 😡 
 
1. Take a Fish from a base 🤫 
2. Escape the Fish Monster chasing you 😱😡 
3. Bring them back to your base to earn money 💵 
 

🐠 Your Fish earn cash OFFLINE! 💤 

 
👍 Like the game & join the group
